svg.title: Choose a command to run the needed research steps
svg.desc: An agent prepares reusable analysis scripts and defines recipes in a justfile. Four alternative commands show their configured inputs, scripts and saved outputs. just all prepares the data, fits the statistical model, calculates contrasts and draws figures. just figures reuses saved contrasts. just contrasts reuses a saved statistical fit. just power runs simulation, fitting and summarization. Matching script cards show reuse across recipes. These are example configurations, not automatic dependency detection by just.
svg.text: The agent creates reusable scripts and recipes
